findings.detail: The product_execution.rs added required_function_order marker is fn evaluate_or_readback_temporal_comparison<, while scripts/verify_hepta_callers.py:605-608 accepts only a function marker ending in (. Every affected mutation test first rejects the unchanged source before reaching the intended mutation.
findings.safe_direction: Support exact generic function markers in verifier and preserve positive and adversarial function-order coverage; do not remove the new execute-before-claim guard.

findings.detail: with_circuit_learning_registry runs frozen scope validation at loop-body depth 2, but the manifest only constrains the loop to function depth 1. The original existing counterexample replacing the guard with if false { guard; } unchecked() is accepted. Actual frozen Rust source correctly performs agent-ID -> frozen-scope -> coordinator checks.
findings.safe_direction: Require the scope call directly in the verified request loop body, retaining the existing counterexample and all ordering/owner checks. A global function-depth-1 constraint would incorrectly reject the real loop.
